title: SIMAI Framework public JS API
description: The names a page may call on window.SF (src/core/contracts/public-js-api.json). Each name says whether it is public or internal (status), what it is (kind), when it exists (loaded_by), where the documentation lists it (layer, owner decision D17, 2026-11-11) whether authors see it listed (audience), the line authors read (author) and the page that describes it (doc).

layer.description: core: core.js; loader: the Loader, at sf-loader-init; smart-base: the Smart base and the shared Smart runtime; component: a component's script API, documented on its component's page.

audience.description: public: listed for authors; internal: not listed. An internal status is never listed.

author.description: The one line the documentation shows for the name: one sentence, present tense, no history.

doc.description: The slug of the documentation page that describes the name, without the language and the slashes around it; an anchor after #. Only for a name listed for authors.

members.description: The members a page may read; the browser probe holds each present.

internal_members.description: The object's other enumerable keys at runtime: there, not listed for authors and no promise. The probe holds members and internal_members together equal to the runtime object's enumerable keys.

open_members.description: Why the object's enumerable keys are data rather than API (rules by name, module ids); the probe then holds only members present.
